chunks.description_en: From an elevated catwalk, the viewpoint looks down at B site. The first-person viewpoint fires the Five-SeveN pistol four times while strafing right and left. A grenade detonates in the background.
chunks.description_zh: 从高处走道向下俯瞰B区。第一人称视角使用 Five-SeveN 手枪连续射击四次，同时向右和向左移动。背景中有一颗手雷爆炸。
chunks.view_change: slight yaw turns left and right

chunks.description_en: Moving forward down the walkway, the first-person viewpoint continues firing the Five-SeveN pistol five times. The viewpoint pitches up and down while tracking the area.
chunks.description_zh: 沿着走道向前移动，第一人称视角继续使用 Five-SeveN 手枪射击五次。视点上下晃动，同时观察该区域。
chunks.view_change: pitch up and down with right yaw pan

chunks.description_en: Descending to the concrete floor, the first-person viewpoint crouches and fires the final two shots from the Five-SeveN before standing back up. The camera pans slightly left.
chunks.description_zh: 降落到水泥地面上，第一人称视角蹲下并使用 Five-SeveN 手枪开完最后两枪，然后重新站起。镜头微微向左平移。

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint moves forward-left across the floor, holding the Five-SeveN. Another player model is visible on top of the red containers before falling.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角手持 Five-SeveN 向左前方移动。在红箱子上可以看到另一名玩家模型，随后该模型坠落。

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint moves forward and turns left, approaching a fallen player model lying next to the red containers. Blood decals are visible on the white wall.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角向前移动并向左转，靠近躺在红箱子旁的被击败玩家模型。白色墙壁上可见血迹贴图。
chunks.movement: mixed movement (left strafe -> forward-left strafe -> forward)
chunks.view_change: pitch down and yaw left turn

subject_list.subject_attribute: The agent is equipped with Sport Gloves | Vice, featuring a vibrant pink and blue-gray design. A Five-SeveN pistol is held in a right-handed grip in the lower center of the screen.

environment_detail.opening_view: The first-person perspective opens from an elevated metal walkway with yellow safety railings, looking down onto the concrete floor of B site. Stacks of red and gray hazardous waste containers are visible in the background, set against green and white walls under bright industrial lighting.
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: The space is a wide, open industrial room on the lower level of the facility. A walkway with yellow railings runs along the elevated section. Sightlines extend across the concrete floor toward stacks of storage containers and a corrugated metal structure on the right, with a rolling garage door visible on the left.
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: The ground consists of smooth gray concrete marked with yellow lines. Walls are partitioned into a lower green-painted concrete section and a white plaster upper section. The containers are made of painted metal, and safety railings are constructed of yellow-painted steel pipes.
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: Prominent props include stacks of red and gray hazardous waste storage containers labeled with warning signs, a large gray shipping container on the right, and yellow steel safety railings. A rolling metal shutter door is situated on the far left wall, and a red 'B' site sign is mounted on the right wall.
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: The scene is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent strip fixtures, casting soft shadows across the concrete floor. Visibility remains clear throughout the area, with no smoke or flash occlusion.
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: A standard CS2 crosshair is centered on the screen. The HUD is partially visible at the edges of the frame, showing health, armor, and weapon details.
environment_detail.persistent_world_effects: Blood splatters and decals appear on the white wall next to the red containers in the later half of the clip, following the elimination of another player.

segments.visual_description_long: The viewpoint starts from an elevated position on a metal catwalk within the lower level of an industrial facility. Yellow-painted steel safety railings flank the perspective on the left and right. In the center mid-ground, stacks of red and gray hazardous waste barrels sit against a wall painted green on the lower half and white on the upper half. To the right, a large corrugated white shipping container is positioned on the concrete floor. The floor features yellow warning stripes painted onto the gray concrete. Overhead fluorescent lights illuminate the room, casting soft shadows. <Camera1>The first-person viewpoint turns slightly left then sweeps back to the right.</Camera1> Multiple brief muzzle flashes illuminate the space in the lower center. A grenade detonation occurs in the background, creating a transient puff of dust and smoke.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|> fires a Five-SeveN pistol four times from 00:00.297 to 00:01.062, experiencing recoil and recovery while strafing right and left.</Action1>

segments.visual_description_long: The viewpoint moves slightly forward and down, clearing the yellow safety railing on the right, which moves out of frame. The yellow railing on the left remains partially visible. The concrete floor with yellow painted stripes continues to dominate the lower half of the view. Stacks of red and gray nuclear waste containers remain centered in the mid-ground. The large white shipping container on the right remains stable in the frame. The green and white paneled walls stretch across the background. <Camera2>The perspective tilts upward and then downward while panning slightly right.</Camera2> Periodic bright muzzle flashes are visible in the lower center of the screen, momentarily lighting up the immediate foreground.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action2><|Subject1|> continues firing the Five-SeveN pistol from 00:01.062 to 00:02.062, executing five shots, recovering from recoil, and beginning to crouch down at 00:01.797.</Action2>

segments.visual_description_long: The viewpoint continues to descend off the elevated catwalk onto the main concrete floor. The yellow railing on the left moves further to the left edge of the screen and out of view. The stacks of red and gray barrels in the mid-ground appear larger as the perspective moves closer to them. The white corrugated container on the right remains in the mid-ground. The green-painted wall with a red 'B' site sign is visible on the far right. <Camera3>The viewpoint pans to the left and tilts upward.</Camera3> Muzzle flashes continue to briefly illuminate the center-right foreground.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action3><|Subject1|> fires the final shots of the Five-SeveN pistol from 00:02.062 to 00:02.375 while holding a crouched position, then transitions to standing back up at 00:02.250.</Action3>

segments.visual_description_long: The viewpoint moves forward across the concrete floor, heading directly toward the stack of red and gray hazardous containers. The large white shipping container on the right is now positioned further to the right. On the far left, a white metal rolling garage door is visible, showing some wear and black markings on its surface. Another player model is visible in the mid-ground, standing on top of the red container stack before jumping or falling down. A dark puff of dust or impact debris is visible near the base of the containers. <Camera4>The viewpoint pans continuously to the left as it tracks forward.</Camera4> The overhead lighting remains bright, casting a clear reflection of the fluorescent fixtures onto the polished concrete floor.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action4><|Subject1|> holds the Five-SeveN pistol in a ready position from 00:03.062 to 00:04.062 while walking forward and strafing left.</Action4>

segments.visual_description_long: The viewpoint approaches the corner of the room, coming to a halt near the red container stack and the white rolling garage door on the left. On the concrete floor, a defeated player model lies motionless next to the containers. Prominent dark blood splatters and decals are visible on the white section of the wall directly above the fallen player model and behind the red containers. The yellow lines on the floor run parallel to the camera's base. The large white shipping container on the right is now mostly out of frame. <Camera5>The perspective sweeps right, tilts down, and then pans back left.</Camera5> The perspective tilts downward, focusing on the fallen model and the floor detail.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action5><|Subject1|> holds the Five-SeveN pistol in a stable grip from 00:04.062 to 00:05.062 while moving forward and turning left.</Action5>

subject_list.display_name: 由玩家操控的 CS2 特工
subject_list.subject_attribute: 该特工装备了 Sport Gloves | Vice（运动手套 | 渐变之色），具有鲜艳的粉色和蓝灰色设计。右手以握持姿态将一把 Five-SeveN 手枪呈现在屏幕中下部。

environment_detail.opening_view: 第一人称视角从带有黄色安全栏杆的高空金属走道开始，向下俯瞰B区的混凝土地面。背景中可见成堆的红色和灰色危险废物集装箱，在明亮的工业照明下紧贴着绿色和白色的墙壁。
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: 该空间是设施下层的一个宽敞开阔的工业房间。一条带有黄色栏杆的走道沿着高处延伸。视线穿过混凝土地面，延伸到右侧成堆的集装箱和波纹金属结构，左侧可见卷帘车库门。
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: 地面由光滑的灰色混凝土组成，上面画有黄色线条。墙壁分为下部的绿色涂漆混凝土和上部的白色石膏部分。集装箱由涂漆金属制成，安全栏杆由黄色涂漆钢管制成。
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: 突出的道具包括成堆贴有警告标志的红色和灰色危险废物存储箱，右侧的一个灰色大型集装箱，以及黄色钢制安全栏杆。左侧墙壁上有一个金属卷帘门，右侧墙壁上挂着一个红色的“B”区标志。
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: 现场由头顶的荧光灯条照亮，在混凝土地面上投下柔和的阴影。整个区域的能见度保持清晰，没有烟雾或闪光遮挡。
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: 标准的 CS2 十字准星位于屏幕中央。HUD 在屏幕边缘部分可见，显示生命值、护甲和武器详细信息。
environment_detail.persistent_world_effects: 在视频后半段，击败另一名玩家后，红色集装箱旁边的白色墙壁上出现了血迹和喷漆贴图。

segments.visual_description_long: 视角从工业设施下层金属走道的高处位置开始。黄色涂漆的钢制安全栏杆位于视角的左右两侧。在中央中景，成堆的红色和灰色危险废物桶靠在下半部涂成绿色、上半部涂成白色的墙壁上。在右侧，一个大型波纹白色集装箱放置在混凝土地面上。地面上画有黄色警告条纹。头顶的荧光灯照亮了房间，投下柔和的阴影。<Camera1>第一人称视点稍微向左转，然后向右扫过。</Camera1> 屏幕中下部闪烁着几次短暂的枪口火焰。背景中发生手雷爆炸，产生了一股转瞬即逝的尘土和烟雾。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|>在 00:00.297 至 00:01.062 期间向右和向左移动，同时使用 Five-SeveN 手枪射击四次并承受后坐力与恢复过程。</Action1>

segments.visual_description_long: 视角稍微向前和向下移动，越过右侧的黄色安全栏杆，该栏杆移出画面。左侧的黄色栏杆依然部分可见。画有黄色条纹的混凝土地面继续占据着视野的下半部分。成堆的红色和灰色核废料箱仍位于中景的中央。右侧的白色集装箱在画面中保持稳定。绿色和白色的镶嵌墙壁横跨背景。<Camera2>视角稍微向右平移，同时向上倾斜然后向下倾斜。</Camera2> 屏幕中下部可见周期性的明亮枪口火焰，瞬间照亮了眼前的近景。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action2><|Subject1|>在 00:01.062 至 00:02.062 期间继续使用 Five-SeveN 手枪射击五次，承受后坐力恢复，并于 00:01.797 开始下蹲。</Action2>

segments.visual_description_long: 视角继续从高架走道下降到主混凝土地面上。左侧的黄色栏杆移向屏幕左边缘并消失。随着视角靠近，中景成堆的红色和灰色木桶显得更大。右侧的白色波纹集装箱依然位于中景。最右侧可见挂有红色“B”区标志的绿漆墙壁。<Camera3>视点向左平移并向上倾斜。</Camera3> 枪口火焰继续短暂照亮中右侧的近景。混凝土地面上的黄色线条在场景中呈对角线排列。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action3><|Subject1|>在 00:02.062 至 00:02.375 期间保持下蹲状态并使用 Five-SeveN 手枪完成最后几次射击，随后在 00:02.250 开始站起。</Action3>

segments.visual_description_long: 视角在混凝土地面上向前移动，直接朝向红色和灰色的危险品集装箱堆。右侧的大型白色集装箱此时位于更靠右的位置。在最左侧，一个白色的金属卷帘车库门清晰可见，表面有一些磨损和黑色痕迹。在中景中，可以看到另一名玩家模型在坠落前站在红色集装箱堆的顶部。集装箱底部附近可见一小团黑色的尘土或撞击碎片。<Camera4>视角在向前推进时持续向左平移。</Camera4> 头顶的照明依然明亮，在抛光的混凝土地面上投射出荧光灯具的清晰倒影。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action4><|Subject1|>在 00:03.062 至 00:04.062 期间手持 Five-SeveN 手枪保持准备姿态，同时向前并向左移动。</Action4>

segments.visual_description_long: 视角接近房间的角落，在红色集装箱堆和左侧的白色卷帘车库门附近停下。在混凝土地面上，一名被击败的玩家模型一动不动地躺在集装箱旁。倒下的玩家模型上方以及红色集装箱后方的白色墙壁区域，可见明显的深色血迹和喷漆贴图。地面上的黄色线条与相机的底边平行。右侧的大型白色集装箱此时已大部分移出画面。<Camera5>视角向右扫过，向下倾斜，然后向左转回。</Camera5> 视角向下倾斜，专注于倒下的模型和地面细节。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action5><|Subject1|>在 00:04.062 至 00:05.062 期间稳步手持 Five-SeveN 手枪，同时向前移动并向左转弯。</Action5>
